meta.name: Annotation Measurements
meta.description: Measure annotated regions: area and distances in physical units, intensity statistics, % positive and connected-component counts, with a canvas-first panel for comparing regions against each other, a class, or a derived tissue mask.

csvCopied: Table copied to clipboard as CSV.
pickHint: Click an annotation on the canvas
pickArmed: Picking… click a region (Esc to cancel)
pickOperandB: Pick what to compare it against.
tissueRatioHint: Derive the tissue mask around this annotation and report the annotation's share of it. The mask stays on the slide as annotations.

metricHelp.area: Area enclosed by the annotation, in slide units. Exact geometry — no sampling involved.
metricHelp.perimeter: Length of the annotation outline, in slide units.
metricHelp.length: Length of the path from its first to its last point, in slide units. An open shape has no area.
metricHelp.tissueRatio: Annotation area ÷ area of the tissue mask derived around it, as of the last derivation. The mask polygons remain on the slide.
metricHelp.mean: Mean intensity (0–255) of the sampled channel over the pixels inside the annotation.
metricHelp.percentPositive: Share of the sampled pixels at or above the threshold.
metricHelp.components: Number of separate positive blobs (4-connected) inside the annotation.
metricHelp.density: Positive blobs per mm² of annotation area. Needs a µm-calibrated slide.

geometryHint: Computed from the annotation shape alone; always up to date.
pixelsHint: The annotation is rendered off-screen and its pixels sampled. Nothing is sampled until you press Measure.
sampledHint: What the pixel metrics were sampled from: the source layer, the channel projected to intensity, and the cut used for % positive and objects. Change these under Advanced sampling in the panel.
measureHint: Sample the pixels inside this annotation: mean intensity, % positive, objects and density.
openPanelHint: Open the measurements panel: compare this annotation with another one, a whole class or a derived tissue mask, measure many annotations into a table, and change the sampling channel, source and threshold.
ratioNa: Ratio unavailable — the denominator has no area.
compositionEmpty: No annotations fall inside this region.
noResults: Nothing in scope. Draw or select an annotation.

reason.noApi: Visualization API isn't reachable from this module. Reload the page; if it keeps failing, the build is missing the visualization-api global bridge.
reason.noActiveVisualization: No visualization is active. Enable a visualization layer first, then measure again.
reason.noVisualization: No visualization is active. Enable a visualization layer first, then measure again.
reason.outOfViewport: {{count}} annotation(s) are off-screen. Pan/zoom to bring them into view; partial overlaps are sampled automatically.
reason.tooSmall: {{count}} annotation(s) are below the 16-pixel minimum after downscaling.
reason.renderFailed: Standalone render failed for {{count}} annotation(s). Try toggling the active visualization off and on; check the browser console for details.
reason.renderEmpty: Standalone render produced no pixels for {{count}} annotation(s).
reason.noSample: Sampler returned no data for {{count}} annotation(s).
reason.noCoverage: {{count}} annotation(s) cover an unpainted region (no tile loaded there, or a fully transparent overlay). Nothing to measure.
reason.noBackground: No background image layer is available to sample.
reason.noImage: No image is open in this viewer.
reason.noDrawer: This viewer has no renderer able to sample off-screen.
reason.noGl: WebGL is unavailable, so pixels cannot be read back.
reason.notFullyLoaded: The region did not finish rendering, so it was not measured. Wait for the slide to settle and measure again.
reason.renderStalled: Rendering the region stalled — some tiles never arrived. Nothing was measured.
reason.emptyBbox: {{count}} annotation(s) have an empty bounding box.
reason.degenerateBounds: {{count}} annotation(s) resolve to a degenerate region.
reason.unsupportedShape: {{count}} annotation(s) have a shape this tool can't rasterize (only polygons / rects / ellipses are supported).
reason.noPathology: Tissue derivation needs the pathology module, which is not loaded.
reason.tissueEmpty: No tissue was detected in this view.
reason.unknown: {{count}} annotation(s) failed with no specific reason.

swapNotForComposition: Composition breaks down a single region, so there is nothing to swap
tissueReachHint: Islands further from the selected region than this are discarded. Relative to the current zoom.
tissueReachNoSubject: Select a region first to filter by distance; every island is kept.
tissueEmpty: No tissue was detected in this view.
thresholdNoteAuto: auto threshold {{value}} · {{- channel}} — computed per annotation, so rows are not comparable
tissueUnavailable: Tissue mask — needs the pathology module
